summary: One church (St. Christopher, 13301 Proctor Rd.). Both November issues print the same Masses box (Sat 5 PM; Sun 8, 10, 12; Mon-Fri 8:30; Sat 8 AM) and confession times (Tue after 8:30 Mass, Wed 6:30-7:15 PM, Sat after 8 AM Mass, Sat 3:45-4:30 PM), and the website matches. A 24/7 code-entry Adoration chapel beside the school is recorded as one 24h slot. No open questions; the Nov 8-10 Forty Hours and Nov 7 memorial Mass are past as_of.
